speaker: The Chairman
text: With the assistance of the digital timer in the Chamber, I trust that hon Members will be able to keep to the speech times indicated against their amendments.

speaker: The Chairman
text: I would urge hon Members both from the front as well as the backbenchers to adhere to their time limits, as I – not just me, my deputies as well – will be stringent in our time-keepings.
